title: Did Rapa Nui collapse before Europeans came?
summary: The ecocide story of a pre-contact collapse is highly controversial. Critics find no conclusive evidence of collapse before 1722 and blame later disease and slave raiding.
why: Rapa Nui is the world's favourite parable of environmental self-destruction; the parable may be wrong.

notes.problem: Megadrought mention without its authors' conclusion (no abrupt pre-contact collapse) reads as support for ecocide.

question: Did Rapa Nui society collapse from deforestation before European contact, or only after it?
evidence: Settlement best estimate 12th century; rats and land clearing caused deforestation; 2021 and 2024 studies find steady growth to 1722 and no genetic sign of collapse.
wouldSettle: Dated settlement and population records across the island spanning 1550 to 1722.

theories.name: Ecocide collapse
theories.idea: Diamond: deforestation destabilised society before Europeans arrived.

theories.name: Post-contact catastrophe
theories.idea: Hunt, Lipo and others: population grew until contact, then disease and slave raiding devastated it.
